name: Dr. Judith Kravitz
reason: Health rule: her Transformational Breath work is sold on conditions across her own sites (read 4 Nov 2026). The flagship Essentials online course (onthewingsofbreath.com, $1,497) opens with 'Constant Anxiety', 'Lingering Trauma', 'Chronic Fatigue' and 'Unexplained Physical Pain' and promises to calm anxiety and ease physical pain; the Breath Discovery Camp and 40-Day Prosperity Program are sold on managing anxiety; the home page claims immune, lung and cardiovascular benefits; and the About page frames the method's origin as healing a throat tumour. Only the facilitator training, free monthly gatherings and some guided-meditation videos would pass, so the work as a whole fails the strict health rule. Judgement call: a human may disagree and list her on those items alone. Note: no general email is shown on the page (contact form at transformationalbreath.com/contactpage-1120); the Foundation's site does not mention The Shift Network on the pages read.
